mapper.sql: WITH extracted_results AS ( SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.submitted_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.result_json) THEN s.result_json ELSE NULL END, '$.typeCode')) AS type_code, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.result_json) THEN s.result_json ELSE NULL END, '$.scaleName')) AS scale_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.result_json) THEN s.result_json ELSE NULL END, '$.scaleVersion')) AS scale_version, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.result_json) THEN s.result_json ELSE NULL END, '$.scoringVersion')) AS scoring_version FROM assessment_session s WHERE s.enterprise_id = 1 AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s.submitted_at IS NOT NULL ), ranked_results AS ( SELECT id, user_id, submitted_at, type_code, scale_name, scale_version, scoring_version, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS assessment_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC) AS result_rank FROM extracted_results WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(type_code, '^[EI][SN][TF][JP]$', 'c') )

u.id AS user_id, u.user_name, u.real_name, u.role_code, u.user_status, u.department_id, COALESCE(d.department_name, '未分配部门') AS department_name, u.position_id, COALESCE(j.position_name, '未分配岗位') AS position_name, p.hire_date, COALESCE(p.employment_status, 'ACTIVE') AS employment_status, COALESCE(r.assessment_count, 0) AS assessment_count, r.id AS latest_result_id, r.type_code, r.submitted_at, r.scale_name, r.scale_version, r.scoring_version

FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN employee_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN sys_position j ON j.id = u.position_id LEFT JOIN ranked_results r ON r.user_id = u.id AND r.result_rank = 1 WHERE u.audit_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select:
SELECT u.department_id, COALESCE(d.department_name, '未分配部门') AS department_name, r.type_code, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, SUM(COALESCE(r.assessment_count, 0)) AS assessment_count
GROUP BY u.department_id, d.department_name, r.type_code ORDER BY u.department_id, r.type_code
